lines.text: Morning. How have the hips been since last time?
Since last time the morning stiffness has lasted about an hour, though I can't be certain because I'm usually rushing the dog out, and it eases once I'm moving.
And what about the evening pain you mentioned before?
The evening pain's gone completely since last time, no doubt about that.
Good. Lie on your back and I'll bend the hip up. You've lost a little turning inwards on the left compared to the right.
Carry on with the stretches twice a day, and try a warm shower first thing before you do them.
Will do. Same time in a month?
Yes, a month is fine. Have a good evening.
